reviews.title: Fraudulent business practices
reviews.text: Mediocre ap, poor diet/meal support. Workouts are not very flexible for home/gym options and super-repetitive. Worst part: fraudulent business practice. Auto renew at $250 with zero communication, rude, condescending and super-slow emails about account and refusal to refund my fraudulently charged renewal fee after cancelling. Do not risk your money or patience in trying to work with Alexia’s team. Terrible ethics.

reviews.title: These workouts kick my butt!!!
reviews.text:
I love this app but the latest update to the app is really irritating. There is absolutely no way to pause the timers anymore if the workout gets interrupted by a phone call or something; the time switching between exercises is too short to change equipment especially with the lack of ability to pause; and lastly, I used to be able to switch back and forth between the gym/home version in the middle of the workout/between circuits (according to the equipment I have) without losing progress on the workout….but now you have to start the workout over. 
Please change these things back. Everything else has been pretty great up until now.

reviews.title: Beware of renewal
reviews.text: I paid for a one year subscription and didn’t realize Alexia Clark sets these accounts up for auto renewal. I never received any notice about the time for renewal. My credit card was charged full price for the following year and as soon as I realized it, which was within days of the charge, I reached out to Alexia Clark to see if I could cancel and get a refund. She would not do any refund amount for the future year. It’s terrible customer service. Buyer be warned!

reviews.title: Best workout app
reviews.text: I have lifted for 2 decades. I know how to lift, I have worked with trainers enough to know form, how to challenge myself, etc. Trainers are expensive. Other workout programs are similar in price, but not nearly as effective. There are movements I question if I can do on here, but then I try and find I can! There’s also modifications if you’re not there yet. This app is the best way I have found to challenge myself, mix it up, and test my limits at an affordable price.

reviews.title: Incredible Guided Workouts
reviews.text: I was on the hunt for a workout app for a while. I’m the kind of person who needs to just be told what to do so that I can get in and out of the gym. This app so far has exceeded my expectations. It really pushes the muscles to exhaustion each day. It’s thorough, detailed and so well thought out. Alexia Clark did an incredible job putting workouts together in a digestible format with easy to follow, written and visual instructions. I would recommend to anyone looking for a workout program that guarantees results. It’s been amazing thus far!

reviews.title: Lacks A lot
reviews.text: The app lacks so much. The timer pauses if I want to just quickly change my music. Beyond that the pauses the timer causes in music to count down is super irritating. I should be able to have the option of adding an additional circuit while I’m in the workout. It doesn’t show how much time has lapsed consistently. I also should be able to go back and see what workouts I did. I would like the ability to log weight and measurements as well.
